comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Sailor Equipment; available on Maris via cove.

Stats: H.Sail: +2 / V.Sail +8 / T.Speed +2 / W.Resistance -1
Effect: Retaliate R5 (requires Evade Melee Battle )

Source: uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=3672

comments.author: Jebi
comments.body: Two things that need clarification: (1) Does the Retaliate EX effect proc during PVP (or is it limited to PVE); and (2) does the Retaliate EX effect proc when equipped on a turtle ship.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I can help with the first; the skill description states clearly that it does not trigger in PvP battles. I can't comment on the second though it's been my observation that all sailor equipment of this nature tends to rely on existing ship skills for their effect to function.
